description: We are developing a fast and efficient system to combine MODIS and VIIRS satellite data into a single, unified map of thermal anomalies. By treating the satellite feeds as raw telemetry, we use a custom low-level processing engine to align the data perfectly in space and time. Our solution automatically resolves the differences in sensor resolutions and observation schedules, delivering a clean, optimized dataset of active fires that is ready for instant AI analysis and real-time monitoring.
